spec: CONTROL.md §6 `prompt`, The mark is made of the message's `id`, and only of a whole one
note: What a machine names a message by when it hands it to a live session in place, from the `id` the receiver gave it (HTTP.md §3; unsigned). `mark` is what goes into the message's frame (`Message via <host> (sessionpipe control, signed on the sender's device; <mark>):`, and for an ask `… with sessionpipe ask, <mark>. …`) and is looked for in the session's transcript; `channel` is what a channel's tag carries and is looked for the same way. Both are null for an id that is not a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): nothing of such an id reaches the session, the message is framed without a mark, it is not handed to a channel or written into an inbox, and an answer in place is acked with no reply.

cases.name: a ULID with a line break after it
a ULID with a space before it
